# HA Workouts

> A free, open-source Home Assistant custom integration (installed via HACS)
> that pulls workout and daily health data from Garmin, Coros, Strava, and
> Apple Health into Home Assistant as native sensors, long-term statistics,
> and calendar events with per-km split detail.

HA Workouts is for Home Assistant users who want their running, cycling, and
other workout data — and related health metrics like heart rate, HRV, sleep,
recovery, and training load — available as sensors inside Home Assistant,
alongside the rest of their smart home data. It is not a fitness app itself;
it is an integration that connects existing fitness-tracking accounts
(Garmin Connect, Coros, Strava, Apple Health) to Home Assistant.

## What it does

- Imports activities (runs, rides, swims, walks, hikes, strength training,
  yoga) from Garmin, Coros, Strava, and Apple Health as Home Assistant
  sensors and long-term statistics (for Statistics Graph / Statistics cards:
  monthly totals, year-to-date, year-over-year comparisons).
- Imports historical activity data in the background on setup (configurable
  depth, from 90 days up to full history).
- Creates one calendar entity per activity type (e.g. "Running activities"),
  each event showing distance, duration, pace, heart rate, and — for Garmin —
  a full per-km split breakdown (pace, heart rate, power, cadence, ground
  contact time, elevation per km).
- Exposes daily health metrics where the source provides them: steps,
  resting heart rate, HRV, sleep score, recovery, training load, body
  battery, stress.
- Tracks all-time personal bests (fastest 1K/5K/10K/half marathon/marathon
  split ever recorded) for Garmin.
- Works with Home Assistant's built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
  integration, so any of its sensors can be exposed to an MCP-capable AI
  assistant (e.g. Claude) for natural-language queries about a user's
  training history.

## Who this is for

Home Assistant users who already have a Garmin, Coros, Strava, or Apple
Watch/Health setup and want that data visible and chartable inside their
existing Home Assistant dashboards, rather than only inside each fitness
platform's own app.

## Key links

- Repository: https://github.com/mrvautin/ha-workouts
- Full documentation (setup instructions per source, data exposed, charting
  examples, troubleshooting): https://github.com/mrvautin/ha-workouts/blob/main/README.md
- Installation: via HACS (Home Assistant Community Store) as a custom
  repository — see the README's Installation section.
